descriptionText:
This 1997 Topps all star trading card features Ivan Rodriguez of the Texas Rangers. The card is made of high-quality card stock and is an original, not a licensed reprint. It is a single card from the base set and is in standard size. The card is in English language and was manufactured by Topps in the United States. 

This card is a must-have for any Major League Baseball (MLB) fan or collector. It is a vintage card from the 1997 season and is part of the all-star team. The card features the player's name, team, and position. It is a great addition to any sports trading card collection.
